column1: # Reference rows for the three non-Malaysian presets (FEAT-0054, ADR-020).
# Taken from the adhan crate 0.2.0 test fixture adhan_js_times.tsv, which holds the output of
# the adhan-js library (MIT, Batoul Apps), the implementation most prayer apps use.
# Columns: latitude, longitude, year, month, day, method, madhab, then fajr sunrise dhuhr asr
# maghrib isha as UTC clock readings. This checks our wiring of the presets, the Asar setting
# and the placement of a UTC reading on the right day; it is not an independent timetable.
